explanation: Welsh sportsman John Graham Chambers drafted them, and they were published in 1867 under the Marquess's sponsorship. They brought in padded gloves and three-minute rounds.

claims.text: The Queensberry Rules of boxing were drafted by John Graham Chambers and published in 1867 under the sponsorship of the 9th Marquess of Queensberry, who did not write them.
John Graham Chambers was a Welsh sportsman.
The Queensberry Rules required padded gloves and three-minute rounds.
